description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing target player to mill cards equal to Aether Channeler's power.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing target player to mill cards equal to Aether Channeler's power.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
